ops.old: Parmesan and herb crackers scored with a maze pattern and studded with rosemary and parsley, with a snowy whipped feta dip. Rub 80g cold butter into 150g plain flour, 40g grated parmesan, 1 tbsp chopped rosemary, 1 tbsp chopped parsley and half a tsp salt, then add 2 to 3 tbsp cold water to bring it together. Chill 20 minutes, roll 3mm thick between baking paper and cut into squares. Score a maze into each with a knife. Bake at 180C for 12 minutes. Whip 150g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest.
